description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム Twilight AXIS』仕様のＲ・ジャジャがＨＧシリーズにて登場！特徴的な機体カラーを成形色で再現！
description.en: "Mobile Suit Gundam Twilight AXIS" specification R Jaja is now available in the HG series! Reproduce the characteristic aircraft color with molded color!

description.ja: ●　特徴的な機体カラーを成形色にて再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the characteristic aircraft color with molded color!

description.en: Twilight AXIS Ver. The white and purple two-tone and pink accents are reproduced by molding color and parts division.

description.en: ● Various standard equipment of R Jaja is included.
